name: Ask
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are encouraged to ask God with confidence, promising that those who ask will receive, seek will find, and knock will have doors opened to them, as emphasized in Matthew 7:7 and Luke 11:9. Prayer offered in faith is assured to bring answers, as Matthew 21:22 and Mark 11:24 affirm the necessity of believing to receive what is asked. Furthermore, asking in Jesus' name is highlighted as the proper approach that glorifies the Father through the Son (John 14:13), and abiding in Christ ensures that requests aligned with His words will be granted (John 15:7). This teaching underscores a Christ-centered, faith-filled approach to prayer that is both relational and powerful.
